input: Fixed normalized centered scalar Gaussian of PR 293; C0 chain/three interior pairs, C1/one interior pair; same clock, density, gravity phases and coefficients 1/2 as PR 317.
comparison: Test each of the three inherited reduced one-mode subsystems for unambiguous records; construct a symmetric two-direction witness on the preselected reduced pair 7,8 tracing 9, and check the other two pairs for comparison. Include canonically conjugate momenta. No independent order register.
instrument: Test a normalized annihilator supported on the specified pair that kills the competitor Gaussian. Click equals non-vacuum. Randomize between the two tests to give both branches the same efficiency. Verify exact positivity, zero cross-talk and the ignored mode's absence.
observables: Unconditional record probabilities for one/three pairs, accepted inconclusive, and boundary failure. X = +1/-1/0/0 respectively. Retain total interference. Test the density switch and clock-width switch with the two-mode 7,8 readout, with inclusive retained labels and the inherited constant boundary-mode analyser separately.
null_control: C0 dust action on both branches, original branch gravity phases and scalar maps. Balanced score identically zero in the reference for either analyser. Also report each conclusive branch probability.
tolerances: Exact rational comparisons for Gaussian claims. Numerical probability regression absolute tolerance 5e-12 on grids 32/6, 64/8, 96/12. No grid-only interval claims.
status: Physical status requires the boundary pairing, admissible input sector and instrument to be physically selected. A calibrated record on the common reduced scalar space is conditional.
